rationale: ENABLED: this build is published by LeoZhang as an independent derivative, so its one-click updater must verify releases signed with LeoZhang's own key, not upstream's. Sign-Release.ps1 derives the expected private key from this constant.
risk: This intentionally ends compatibility with upstream-signed releases. It also requires re-applying after every upstream edit to UpdateValidation.cs; fork_overlay.py does that automatically and fails loudly if the anchor disappears. public.xml is deliberately TRACKED so CI can replay the patch; logs/fork/keys/private.xml stays gitignored and must never be committed.
